notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) via background subagents covering 2026-10-17/18, ~185 queries total. Unusually quiet for same-day announcements across every lane — no qualifying 'announcement' entry (dated exactly Oct 17 or 18) cleared the bar in any lane; search indices appear thin for the exact window. The calendar is dense enough (672 entries) that the large majority of forward-looking candidates each lane surfaced (FTC v. Amazon Mar 29 2027 date, GTC Washington DC, GTC 2027 San Jose, ICLR 2027, NeurIPS 2026, Node.js 24/26 LTS transitions, GitHub Universe 2026, Mistral Large 4, AI21 Jamba Bedrock EOL, OpenAI realtime/audio retirement, Claude Opus 4.6 support floor, AWS/Azure Saudi Arabia + Chile region launches) were already on file at equal or better precision/sourcing, so left untouched. Genuinely new this run that was actually filed: one AWS EKS Kubernetes 1.34 support-lifecycle date and a day-precision tightening of Apple's rumored LA hardware showcase from month to Oct 27-28. Three more Claude model minimum-support-floor exit dates (Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8) were found on Anthropic's own deprecations page but withheld after a dry-run revealed they'd all wrongly merge into the existing Opus 4.6 entry due to a dedupe bug — see concerns.
concerns: FTC v. Certificate-policy duplicate clusters remain from prior runs: three near-identical Let's Encrypt 64-day-certificate entries in data/events/2027-02.json, three near-identical CA/Browser Forum 100-day entries in data/events/2027-03.json, and two near-identical Mozilla root-distrust entries in data/events/2027-04.json — all already correctly dated at exact-day precision (re-confirmed this run), so not touched again, but still waiting on a maintainer merge.

data/events/2027-04.json also carries two near-duplicate ICLR 2027 entries ('iclr-2027-2027-04' and 'international-conference-on-learning-representations-iclr-20-2027-04'), both already at the correct Apr 26-30 2027 dates — not re-filed a third time; a maintainer should merge the pair.

Found a reproducible dedupe bug in src/lib/id.ts's isSameThing/sameTitle: Anthropic's deprecations page also lists minimum-support-floor exit dates for Claude Sonnet 4.6 (2027-02-17), Opus 4.7 (2027-04-16) and Opus 4.8 (2027-05-28), genuinely new and distinct from the already-filed Opus 4.6 entry (2027-02-05) — but a --dry-run of filing all three showed every one of them merging into the single existing 'anthropic-claude-opus-4-6-reaches-minimum-guaranteed-support-2027-02' entry instead of creating three new ones. Titles like 'Claude Opus 4.7 reaches minimum guaranteed support floor' share 8/9 tokens with 'Claude Opus 4.6 reaches...' (only the version digit differs), clearing sameTitle's 0.6 Jaccard threshold, and EVENT_DRIFT_DAYS=75 plus apparent date-chaining (each merge appears to shift the canonical date forward before the next comparison) lets dates up to ~112 days apart still collapse into one entry. Deliberately NOT filed this run to avoid corrupting the Opus 4.6 entry — a maintainer should tighten sameTitle to require the version-number token to match, not just clear a word-overlap ratio, before these can be safely filed.
